changes: Research wrapper validates every supplied price_jpy with existing finite Decimal parser and requires >0, including partial quotes, before policy/position decision gates. Old pure evaluator is unchanged by this fix.
Raw source snapshots remain exact for snapshot SHA/receipt/persistence; separate validate_source copies are passed only to quote helpers and financial calculation.
Raw IR metadata omission still records missing reply identity/publicity holds rather than KeyError; no raw default fields are inserted.
fixtures: Synthetic only; in-memory/temp databases, no live financial data.
parent_reported_findings: Source-bound zero/negative price could bypass validation when position or policy was unresolved.
Schema-valid raw market sources omitting metadata/requires_research could raise KeyError in quote helpers that expected validated defaults.
